description: Text input with label, help, prefixes and error messaging.

howToUse: Use it for one line of free text: name, e-mail, link, amount.
Always give it a `label`. Use `hint` for the format expected ("Only numbers"), and `error` to say what is wrong and how to fix it.
Set the right `type` (`email`, `url`, `tel`, `number`): the mobile keyboard changes with it.
Use `prefix` and `suffix` for fixed parts, such as a currency symbol or a domain.
alternatives: Picking from known options: Select or Combobox.
Phone, postal code or verification code: PhoneInput, PostalCodeInput or Otp.

keyboard.action: Submits the form the field is in, as in any browser field.

props.name: label
props.description: Uppercase mono label above the field.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message (replaces the hint and colors the border).

props.name: prefix
props.description: Fixed content on the left (icon or a prefix like "example.com/").

props.name: suffix
props.description: Fixed content on the right (icon or suffix).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
